name: qkd_ctrl_pc_port_child_nc-n1-COMMIT
purpose: KV-PLAN-CI 2026-10-17 (coordinator decision 3): ci-less successor of the closed/kitted qkd_ctrl_pc_port_s3: the legacy controller command / KV-write word ci (319 b) has no producer on the static die, so its pin flops and the legacy write path are REMOVED logic (not tied inputs). Lockstep vs the original with ci held 0 under the compiled die calendar images (tools/qwen_kv_die/kvplan_ci_nc_gate.sh: 12/12 PASS, 3 mutants FAIL LOCKSTEP). PARAMS = the qkd_static_kv_pc_path_nc instance values. Port child: kw_vi / kw_di W pins and cv_q / cdata_q pin flops removed; same outline (E face pi + em pin-bound) / faces as port_s3.
